prompt:
Paint ONE building for a top-down pixel-art JRPG town map, in the classic 3/4 top-down RPG view: the roof is seen from above (it fills the upper coloured block of the guide) and the front wall is seen straight on (the lower block). The attached image is an exact layout guide drawn at the final proportions: keep the outer silhouette, the roof/wall split line, the door (dark brown rectangle: it must stay exactly there, same size, at ground level, a real door you can walk through) and the windows (yellow rectangles) in exactly the same places. You may add small details (eaves, trim, drainpipe, flower boxes, crates by the wall, a chimney poking above the roof into the empty top margin).
This building: a two-storey boatyard workshop in a stone-and-plaster harbour town on a windy northern coast. dark brown wooden shingle roof walls of vertical weathered wooden planks. Windows have small panes glowing warm amber from inside (the only light). a hanging wooden sign with an anchor icon beside the door. A small iron wall lamp next to the door (unlit glass). The whole image is 208 x 224 art pixels (each art pixel 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent (the magenta in the guide is background). No ground, no shadow, no people, no text, no letters.

Preserve openings in their exact positions and sizes: upstairs windows x=392..504 y=1036..1176 and x=938..1050 y=1036..1176; ground-floor window x=868..980 y=1344..1484; real accessible ground-level doorway x=539..693 y=1344..1567. Keep the door dark brown and windows warm amber with tiny mullions within each existing rectangular opening; do not shift them. 3/4 top-down JRPG building: upper roof visible from above, lower facade straight-on. Two-storey boatyard workshop of windy northern harbour, dark brown wooden shingle roof, vertical weathered wooden plank walls, muted stone-and-plaster harbour-town accents and bracing, hanging wooden sign with simple anchor PICTOGRAM beside door, tiny iron wall lamp next to door with unlit glass. Small restrained workshop details if space permits; no people, letters, or ground. Rich earthy 4-6 shade hue-shifted ramps, purple-red shaded brown and warm yellow highlights. Neutral soft even upper-left overcast evening base colors, NO cast shadows, no night tint, no lamp pools. Warm amber windows ONLY luminous elements. Preserve original proportions above all else; transparent alpha background.
